text:
gwen (product): Draft RN for v0.9.3 is ready — https://redwood.internal/rn/v0.9.3-draft. Need ops + legal signoff by EOD. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. We're pinning to v0.9.3-rc2 and doing a small canary first.
liam (eng-release): Ack. I'll wire up the deploybot playbook. Can we confirm rollback criteria (latency, errors, and OOM)?
deploy-bot: Heads up — I can run: `/deploy start v0.9.3 --canary 10% --pin v0.9.3-rc2 --window 23:00-01:00` once you give the green. I will post heartbeats to #eng-oncall.
anya (docs): I'll add a short "what changed" and "migration notes" section. Quick question: do we want to call out embedding index changes in the RN?
gwen (product): yes call out embedding index change — include sample query and expected latency delta. Also note that model config changed: kv-cache retention bumped.
tess (legal): Skimmed the draft. Privacy blurb updated — no customer PII touched, added retention sentence per compliance. I can't sign off on external release copy until marketing reviews, but internal RN is fine.
sam (oncall): I'll be on pager during the window. Rollback trigger proposal: 5m sustained 5xx > 2% OR median latency increase > 100ms vs baseline for 10m. If triggered, call rollback and escalate.
liam (eng-release): Sounds good. I'll add automated metrics checks and a canary -> full rollout step with a manual gate at 50%. Also adding fallback to quantized variant if OOMs appear.
gwen (product): Please add the concrete rollback command to the RN. Something easy to copy.
liam (eng-release): Added snippet to RN: ```bash
# rollback to previous pinned stable
/deploy rollback --to v0.9.2 --reason "auto-trigger:latency-or-errors"
```
liam (eng-release): Also plan B: if model variant causes issues, fallback rule: route traffic to `v0.9.3-q4` (quantized) automatically after 3 OOMs in 2m.
anya (docs): I'll surface the rollback snippet and the routing fallback in the postmortem template too.
deploy-bot: Ready to run preflight checks: config lint, pin verification, and canary policy. Run `/deploy preflight v0.9.3` to start.
gwen (product): Please do preflight now and report back. If all green, we'll send internal announce to #eng and #customer-success 1h before window.
liam (eng-release): Preflight started. Lint: OK. Pin verification: OK. Canary policy: OK. Create canary job at 23:05 UTC.
sam (oncall): Quick note — set alert channel to #eng-oncall and page the oncall rotation. Also include runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-rollbacks.
gwen (product): Great. I'll draft internal announcement blurb: "Deploying v0.9.3 (pin v0.9.3-rc2). Key changes: embeddings index change, kv-cache retention, minor perf tweaks. Canary at 23:05 UTC; full rollout at 23:40 if green. Oncall: Sam. Rollback criteria outlined"
tess (legal): Thanks — I approve the internal blurb. :white_check_mark:
liam (eng-release): All set from infra side. Waiting on one more :+1: from docs to publish RN.
anya (docs): Published RN (internal) and embedded rollback snippet. Leaving marketing / external copy for later.
gwen (product): Perfect — proceeding with pre-announcement in 1h unless someone raises blockers now. :thumbsup:
liam (eng-release): :thumbsup:
sam (oncall): :thumbsup:
tess (legal): :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary at 23:05 UTC. Will post status updates in thread during rollout.
